text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: What did you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Did I succeed in leading by example?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then I am satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Almost a year has passed since I<n>started my
senior year.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If my performance has managed to<n>inspire
younger racers, I can't think<n>of anything more
worthwhile.
choice_data_list: You're not planning to stop now, are you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Don't worry, there's no<n>chance of that.
Can't you see the fire<n>in my eyes?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I'm already looking to the<n>future. My
next challenge will be...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Precisely.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But this will be no repeat of last year.<n>I intend to
show the world the fruits of<n>my labors.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf looks fired up enough<n>already, but I
have one more thing to<n>tell her.
choice_data_list: I hear Maruzensky's going to be there.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky. I see...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: On the way back...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that...

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text:
...And that concludes our tour of the<n>academy. Do
you have any<n>questions?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the student council's general<n>manager. It
looks like she's leading a<n>group of Umamusume
around.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now that I think about it, today was<n>the day that
the new student council<n>members were supposed
to be given<n>a guided tour.

text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
You know... I'm starting to think that<n>maybe the
student council might not<n>be right for me...

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text: Why do you say that?

text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I joined because of the President, but<n>when I saw
her race today...

text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
She was so much better than I could<n>ever hope to
be. I feel like there's no<n>point...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf says nothing. She's<n>waiting to see
how the general<n>manager will respond.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text:
I know what you mean. I felt exactly<n>the same
way when I first joined.

text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Really?

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text:
I thought there was no way I could<n>ever live up to
my station, and it made<n>me feel really down on
myself.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I still feel useless most of<n>the time. But I
can tell you one thing<n>for certain: I've grown a lot
as a<n>person since I began.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager
text_block_list.text:
So if you want to improve yourself...<n>would you
consider hanging in a little<n>longer?

text_block_list.name: Short Umamusume
text_block_list.text: A-all right... I'll give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It's gratifying to see the younger<n>students
maturing off the track as<n>well as on it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And it's a relief to know that the<n>academy will be
in safe hands even<n>after I'm gone.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf looks like a weight<n>has been lifted
from her shoulders.<n>This is the perfect time to
spring my<n>proposal!
choice_data_list: There's something I've been meaning to ask you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That's rather sudden, but by all<n>means.
choice_data_list:
I want you to forget about your titles at the Arima
Kinen.

I want you to forget about your titles at the Arima
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I don't want her to race as the<n>Emperor or the
President, but simply<n>as Symboli Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I understand what you're trying to<n>say.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But my pride as the Emperor won't<n>allow it. The
weight of my<n>responsibilities is what makes me
who I am.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What's the harm in setting all that<n>aside once in a
while?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Groove! I didn't see you there.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I was assisting with the tour.<n>But more to
the point...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I concur with your trainer's<n>suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Every time you race, you hold your<n>real self back
in order to be more true<n>to your ideals.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
But now your successors are well on<n>their way to
maturity. I think, just<n>once, you should race the
way you<n>truly want to.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I have raced the way I wanted to.This is the path I chose when Ibecame the Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Why must you insist on<n>being so
hardheaded?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: How about this, then? Do it for us.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: For you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I've always wanted to see how you<n>would race if
you let your heart guide<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you let yourself be nothing more<n>than an
Umamusume seeking a<n>challenge.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I believe I speak for the entire student<n>council
when I say we would relish<n>the learning
experience.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
So, in your capacity as president...<n>would you
show us what it looks like<n>when you race as
Symboli Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Sigh... You know exactly how to pullmy strings, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I've been at this for a while now, you<n>know.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Very well. You win. If both my trainer<n>and my own
right hand turn against<n>me, what am I to do?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
When I race in the Arima Kinen, I will<n>let the titles
of Emperor and President<n>fall by the wayside.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As for what will come of it, I cannot<n>say.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Me neither. It will be a learning<n>experience for both
of us.
